title: Door to Room 217 Propped Open — Maintenance Hallway

lines.text: Dispatch, this is Janitor 7. I'm in the Maintenance Hallway near Concourse B. I just noticed the door to Room 217 — the secondary server closet — is propped open with a rolled-up piece of duct tape. I didn't touch anything. I thought I should report it.
Copy, Janitor 7. Lock the door if you can, but do not enter. We're sending Security to secure the area. Stand by for instructions.

instructorNote: Physical security breach; Security must secure Room 217 and preserve it as a potential crime scene. Only Jordan Kelley has the key. This confirms the room was accessed and tampered with.
